ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with localized high-intensity (white) features accounting for approximately 8-12% of the visible ventral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid black (low-intensity) field. Discrete white circular ring structures (15-40 pixel diameter) are scattered across both lobes. Dense, irregular high-intensity textured clusters are mapped to the distal margins of the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate 75-degree internal angle, showing a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the central trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude irregular protrusions at the distal tips caused by epibiont accumulation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending symmetrically towards the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular white rings; high-density cluster observed in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe and scattered individual rings on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive live barnacle colonization forming irregular calcified clusters on the distal ends of both fluke lobes; numerous circular white scars indicative of past attachment sites.
